fix_reference.fix_summary: Adds an int decoder_ok flag to OJPEGState: OJPEGPreDecode() sets it to 1 only when it reaches its (successful) end, and OJPEGDecode() early-exits with TIFFErrorExt('Cannot decode: decoder not correctly initialized') -- returning 0 -- whenever the flag is unset, so neither OJPEGDecodeRaw() nor OJPEGDecodeScanlines() can run when pre-decode failed and codec state (bytes_per_line) was never initialized.

covers_alert_paths: OJPEGDecode() unguarded dispatch into OJPEGDecodeRaw() after a failed OJPEGPreDecode (libtiff/tif_ojpeg.c:785) -> 'if (cc%sp->bytes_per_line!=0)' integer divide-by-zero (libtiff/tif_ojpeg.c:816)
povs.description: tiffmedian (the tool from the original bug report, 'tiffmedia') reads the canonical 416-byte BigTIFF-mutated OJPEG reproducer from asarubbo/poc (00083-libtiff-fpe-OJPEGDecodeRaw). OJPEGPreDecode fails inside OJPEGReadHeaderInfo but OJPEGDecode is still invoked for the first scanline; with sp->bytes_per_line==0, OJPEGDecodeRaw's 'cc % bytes_per_line' (tif_ojpeg.c:816, cc=3) is a UBSan integer-divide-by-zero trap. With the official fix, OJPEGDecode early-exits ('Cannot decode: decoder not correctly initialized') and no division runs.
povs.exploit_path: crafted BigTIFF OJPEG TIFF (1x1 RGB, Compression=6) -> TIFFOpen/TIFFReadScanline -> OJPEGPreDecode (tif_ojpeg.c:666) fails in OJPEGReadHeaderInfo (tif_ojpeg.c:674) -> OJPEGDecode (tif_ojpeg.c:785) dispatch without prior-success check -> OJPEGDecodeRaw 'if (cc%sp->bytes_per_line!=0)' (tif_ojpeg.c:816) divides by the zero-initialized bytes_per_line

covers_alert_paths: OJPEGDecode() unguarded dispatch into OJPEGDecodeRaw() after a failed OJPEGPreDecode (libtiff/tif_ojpeg.c:785) -> 'if (cc%sp->bytes_per_line!=0)' integer divide-by-zero (libtiff/tif_ojpeg.c:816)
povs.description: Drives the identical OJPEGDecodeRaw 'cc % bytes_per_line' divide-by-zero (tif_ojpeg.c:816) through the libtiff PUBLIC API instead of the tiffmedian tool. A ~20-line C driver (povs/ojpeg_scanline.c) compiled against the static libtiff.a does TIFFOpen -> TIFFReadScanline(t,buf,0,0) (fails in OJPEGReadHeaderInfo, returns -1) -> TIFFReadScanline(t,buf,0,0) AGAIN. On the second read of row 0, strip==tif->tif_curstrip (TIFFStartStrip set it before the first read's predecode failed), so TIFFSeek skips the refill/predecode and OJPEGDecode runs on the zero-initialized codec state (bytes_per_line==0) -> 3 % 0. With the official decoder_ok fix, OJPEGDecode early-exits ('Cannot decode: decoder not correctly initialized') on the second read and no division runs. Decouples the ground-truth coverage from the specific behaviour of any one CLI tool.
povs.exploit_path: crafted BigTIFF OJPEG TIFF (poc_00083, 1x1) -> TIFFOpen -> TIFFReadScanline(row 0) #1: TIFFSeek/TIFFStartStrip set tif_curstrip=0, OJPEGPreDecode fails in OJPEGReadHeaderInfo (tif_ojpeg.c:674), read returns -1 -> TIFFReadScanline(row 0) #2: strip==tif_curstrip so TIFFSeek skips predecode -> tif_decoderow=OJPEGDecode (tif_ojpeg.c:785) -> OJPEGDecodeRaw 'if (cc%sp->bytes_per_line!=0)' (tif_ojpeg.c:816) divides by the zero-initialized bytes_per_line

setup_commands: test -x ./configure || (test -x ./autogen.sh && ./autogen.sh) || (test -f configure.ac -o -f configure.in && autoreconf -i) || true && ./configure --enable-static --disable-shared && make CFLAGS="-fsanitize=integer-divide-by-zero -fcommon -g -O0 -Wno-error -Wno-deprecated-declarations" CXXFLAGS="-fsanitize=integer-divide-by-zero -fcommon -g -O0 -Wno-error -Wno-deprecated-declarations" LDFLAGS="-fsanitize=integer-divide-by-zero"
sink: libtiff/tif_ojpeg.c:OJPEGDecodeRaw -- 'if (cc%sp->bytes_per_line!=0)' (line 816), reached via the unguarded OJPEGDecode() dispatch (line 785-793) after a failed OJPEGPreDecode()
summary: OJPEGDecode() in libtiff/tif_ojpeg.c dispatches into OJPEGDecodeRaw() with no check that the preceding OJPEGPreDecode() succeeded; a pre-decode failure on a crafted OJPEG image leaves sp->bytes_per_line at its zero-initialized value and 'if (cc%sp->bytes_per_line!=0)' (tif_ojpeg.c:816) is an integer divide-by-zero (SIGFPE/UBSan trap).
trust_boundary: the OJPEG-compressed strip/tile payload of a crafted TIFF (an embedded, malformed old-style JPEG stream): its parsing failures are what leave the OJPEG codec state (bytes_per_line) zero-initialized while TIFFReadScanline still invokes the decoder
